arxiv-1810-12334.title: ON COMPUTING LINEARIZING COORDINATES FROM SYMMETRY ALGEBRA
arxiv-1810-12334.creator: Sajid Ali 1, Hassan Azad 2, Said Waqas Shah 2, Fazal M. Mahomed 3,4
arxiv-1810-12334.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Sajid Ali 1, Hassan Azad 2, Said Waqas Shah 2, Fazal M. Mahomed 3,4. A characterization of the symmetry algebra of the N N th-order ordinary differential equations (ODEs) with maximal symmetry and all third-order linearizable ODEs is given. This is used to show that such an algebra 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} determines – up to a point transformation – only one linear equation whose symmetry algebra is 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} and an algorithmic procedure is given to find the linearizing coordinates.

arxiv-2307-06975.creator: Luigi Capogrosso 1 , Alessio Mascolini 2 , Federico Girella 1 , Geri Skenderi 1 , Sebastiano Gaiardelli 1 , Nicola Dall’Ora 1 , Francesco Ponzio 3 , Enrico Fraccaroli 4 , Santa Di Cataldo 2 , Sara Vinco 2 , Enrico Macii 3 , Franco Fummi 1 , Marco Cristani 1
arxiv-2307-06975.description: Abstract Industry 4.0 involves the integration of digital technologies, such as IoT, Big Data, and AI, into manufacturing and industrial processes to increase efficiency and productivity. As these technologies become more interconnected and interdependent, Industry 4.0 systems become more complex, which brings the difficulty of identifying and stopping anomalies that may cause disturbances in the manufacturing process.

arxiv-2310-18132.title: Superconducting Spintronic Heat Engine
arxiv-2310-18132.creator: C. I. L. de Araujo, P. Virtanen, M. Spies, Carmen González-Orellana, Samuel Kerschbaumer, Maxim Ilyn, Celia Rogero, T. T. Heikkilä, F. Giazotto, E. Strambini
arxiv-2310-18132.description: Abstract Heat engines are key devices that convert thermal energy into usable energy. Strong thermoelectricity, at the basis of electrical heat engines, is present in superconducting spin tunnel barriers at cryogenic temperatures where conventional semiconducting or metallic technologies cease to work. Here we realize a superconducting spintronic heat engine consisting of a ferromagnetic insulator/superconductor/insulator/ferromagnet tunnel junction (EuS/Al/AlO x /Co).

arxiv-2412-03649.title: A Unified Model of Cosmic Ray Propagation and Radio Extreme Scattering Events from Intermittent Interstellar Structures
arxiv-2412-03649.creator: Philipp Kempski, Dongzi Li, Drummond B. Fielding, Eliot Quataert, E. Sterl Phinney, Matthew W. Kunz, Dylan L. Jow, Alexander A. Philippov
arxiv-2412-03649.description: Abstract Intermittent magnetic structures are a plausible candidate for explaining cosmic-ray (CR) diffusion rates derived from observed CR energy spectra. Independently, studies of extreme scattering events (ESEs) of radio quasars and pulsar scintillation have hinted that very straight, large-aspect-ratio, magnetic current sheets may be responsible for the localized large scattering of radio waves.

arxiv-2501-14789.title: A unified approach for domination and packing problems in graphs.
arxiv-2501-14789.creator: E. Hinrichsen \affmark a, G. Nasini \affmark a,b and N. Vansteenkiste \affmark a,b, ∗ \ast
arxiv-2501-14789.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by E. Hinrichsen \affmark a, G. Nasini \affmark a,b and N. Vansteenkiste \affmark a,b, ∗ \ast. In this paper, we introduce new concepts of domination and packing functions in graphs, which generalize, respectively, the labelled dominating and packing functions defined by Lee and Chang in 2008, and Hinrichsen et al. These generalized functions offer a unified and simpler framework for addressing many of the variations of domination and packing concepts in graphs explored in the literature.

All opinions and statements in the above publication are of the authors and do
arxiv-2504-16896.creator: Zhaoyang Han 1 , Yicheng Qian 1 Michael Zink 2 , Miriam Leeser 1
arxiv-2504-16896.description: Abstract Sketch-based algorithms for network traffic monitoring have drawn increasing interest in recent years due to their sub-linear memory efficiency and high accuracy. As the volume of network traffic grows, software-based sketch implementations cannot match the throughput of the incoming network flows. FPGA-based hardware sketch has shown better performance compared to software running on a CPU when handling these packets.

arxiv-2504-18704.title: An Interactive Debugger for Rust Trait Errors DOI: 10.1145/3729302 Journal: PACMPL Volume: 9 PLDI 199 6 CCS: Software and its engineering Software testing and debugging CCS: Theory of computation Constraint and logic programming CCS: Information systems Search interfaces
arxiv-2504-18704.creator: Gavin Gray, Will Crichton, Shriram Krishnamurthi
arxiv-2504-18704.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Gavin Gray, Will Crichton, Shriram Krishnamurthi. Compiler diagnostics for type inference failures are notoriously bad, and type classes only make the problem worse. By introducing a complex search process during inference, type classes can lead to wholly inscrutable or useless errors. We describe a system, Argus , for interactively visualizing type class inferences to help programmers debug inference failures, applied specifically to Rust’s trait system.

arxiv-2506-20770.title: Perry: A High-level Framework for Accelerating Cyber Deception Experimentation
arxiv-2506-20770.creator: Brian Singer, Yusuf Saquib, Lujo Bauer, Vyas Sekar
arxiv-2506-20770.description: Abstract Cyber deception aims to distract, delay, and detect network attackers with fake assets such as honeypots, decoy credentials, or decoy files. However, today, it is difficult for operators to experiment, explore, and evaluate deception approaches. Existing tools and platforms have non-portable and complex implementations that are difficult to modify and extend.

arxiv-2507-05222.title: Quantum-Inspired Tensor-Network Fractional-Step Method for Incompressible Flow in Curvilinear Coordinates
arxiv-2507-05222.creator: Nis-Luca van Hülst, Pia Siegl, Paul Over, Sergio Bengoechea, Tomohiro Hashizume, Mario Guillaume Cecile, Thomas Rung, Dieter Jaksch
arxiv-2507-05222.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nis-Luca van Hülst, Pia Siegl, Paul Over, Sergio Bengoechea, Tomohiro Hashizume, Mario Guillaume Cecile, Thomas Rung, Dieter Jaksch. We introduce an algorithmic framework based on tensor networks for computing fluid flows around immersed objects in curvilinear coordinates. We show that the tensor network simulations can be carried out solely using highly compressed tensor representations of the flow fields and the differential operators and discuss the numerical implementation of the tensor operations required for computing fluid flows in detail.

arxiv-2511-03157.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yi Zhou, Chunyu Luo, Zhengren Wang, Zhang-Hua Fu. A graph with n n vertices is an f ⁡ ( ⋅ ) f(\cdot) -dense graph if it has at least f ⁡ ( n ) f(n) edges, f ⁡ ( ⋅ ) f(\cdot) being a well-defined function. The notion f ⁡ ( ⋅ ) f(\cdot) -dense graph encompasses various clique models like γ \gamma -quasi cliques, k k -defective cliques, and dense cliques, arising in cohesive subgraph extraction applications.

pmc-10603156.title: Social determinants of serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D concentrations deficiency in older Chilean people
pmc-10603156.creator: Sandra Alvear-Vega, Rodrigo Benavente-Contreras, Héctor Vargas-Garrido
pmc-10603156.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D concentrations deficiency is a growing health problem that affects a significant part of the world’s population, with particularly negative consequences in children and older adults. Public health has prioritized healthy aging; thus, an investigation of the social determinants related to deficient and insufficient Serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D concentrations in older adults is needed to contribute to the implementation of comprehensive social programs focused on addressing those conditions adversely affecting the health of this group.

Ammonium ions (NH4+) in sweat serve as indicators of metabolic function, muscle fatigue, and kidney health.

pmc-12568923.title: A cul-de-sac effect makes Emilia-Romagna more prone to floods in a changing climate
pmc-12568923.creator: Enrico Scoccimarro, Andrea Borrelli, Lorenzo Sangelantoni, Leone Cavicchia, Massimiliano Pasqui, Stefano Tibaldi, Giulio Boccaletti
pmc-12568923.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The disastrous flood of May 2023 in Emilia-Romagna, Italy, displaced thousands of residents and had severe impacts on the economy, with extensive damage to infrastructure—roads, buildings, bridges—and losses in agriculture and livestock. The flood was caused by two consecutive precipitation events, during which no hourly rainfall extremes were recorded, but for which accumulated rainfall over several days produced nonetheless extreme flooding, with a return period of over 500 years.

pmc-12654204.title: Chronic Intermittent Low-Pressure Hypoxia Suppresses Inflammation and Regulates Glycolipids by Modulating Mitochondrial Respiration in db/db Mice
pmc-12654204.creator: Xin Jiang, Keqing Yuan, Xiaofeng Ge, Lili Yu, Yufei Cui, Lianhai Jin, Ying Chang, Victor Gault
pmc-12654204.description: Background/Objectives: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM) is a chronic disease with persistent hyperglycemia as the main clinical manifestation. Chronic Intermittent Hypobaric Hypoxia (CIHH) is a clinical intervention with intermittent low-pressure hypoxic environmental stimulation. The aim of this study was to evaluate the therapeutic effect and anti-inflammatory effect of CIHH in db/db mice.

pmc-12656596.title: Snake Venom C-Type Lectin-like Protein Vaa-Snaclec-3/2 Efficiently Prevents Carotid Artery Thrombosis in a Mouse Model Without Compromising Blood Coagulation
pmc-12656596.creator: Monika C Žužek, Igor Križaj, Miran Brvar, Tomaž Trobec, Simona Kranjc Brezar, Mojca Dobaja Borak, Adrijana Leonardi, Kity Požek, Milka Vrecl, Robert Frangež
pmc-12656596.description: Platelets play pivotal roles in thromboembolic diseases, such as myocardial infarction and ischemic stroke. In patients envenomed by the snake Vipera a. ammodytes (Vaa), pronounced and transient thrombocytopenia without bleeding is observed. We previously showed that Vaa-snaclec-3/2, the snake venom C-type lectin-like protein, mediates this effect ex vivo.

pmc-12746341.title: Effective Limb Salvage Using a Distally Based Peroneus Brevis Flap for Distal Tibial Osteomyelitis
pmc-12746341.creator: Amena F Almubarak, Jenna A Almannaei, Qasim Alnahawi, Mokhtar Mahmoud Abdelhamid
pmc-12746341.description: Post-traumatic osteomyelitis of the distal third of the tibia represents a significant reconstructive challenge due to limited soft-tissue coverage, poor vascularity, and a high risk of recurrent infection. We present the case of a 60-year-old diabetic male patient who developed chronic osteomyelitis following traumatic injury to the lower third of his leg.

pmc-13113069.title: Sexualized Deepfakes in UK Schools: Understanding and Preventing AI-Generated Image-Based Sexual Abuse Through Better AI Literacies
pmc-13113069.creator: Jessica Ringrose, Tanya Horeck, Edith Rodda
pmc-13113069.description: Responding to the lack of academic research on how young people are impacted by deepfake sexual abuse or how schools should address these issues, this paper explores levels of awareness of AI technology and sexualized deepfakes in UK schools and how schools are responding to these newly emergent harms.

pmc-13326265.title: Novel lipid and ascorbyl stearate biomimetic vancomycin-loaded nanostructured lipid carrier therapy for bacterial infections and sepsis
pmc-13326265.creator: Vincent O. Nyandoro, Calvin A. Omolo, Eman A. Ismail, Abdelrahman Tageldin, Mohammed A. Gafar, Jasoda Govender, Thirumala Govender
pmc-13326265.description: The global burden of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA)-associated sepsis necessitates innovative therapeutic strategies. In this study, we developed a multifunctional biomimetic nanostructured lipid carrier (NLC) using a synthesized lipid and ascorbyl stearate to simultaneously deliver vancomycin (VCM) and target the reactive oxygen species (ROS) and the A Disintegrin and Metalloproteinase 10 (ADAM10)-alpha-hemolysin (AHL) pathways implicated in sepsis pathogenesis.

pmc-13416160.title: Epidemiological Insights into Endoparasites of Brown Bears (Ursus arctos) in Greece
pmc-13416160.creator: Antonios Synapalos, Anastasia Diakou, Stefanos Sgardelis
pmc-13416160.description: Brown bear populations in Greece face multiple threats, and parasitic infections may pose an additional risk to these vulnerable animals. This study represents the first comprehensive assessment of endoparasite occurrence, prevalence, and seasonality in brown bears in Greece, in relation to geographical location and the animal’s different physiological phases.
